# Explicit instance values from verified base defaults

Status: Implemented on an independent next-cycle branch; not part of the frozen release.

A static declaration default cannot represent a project's modified balance resource
or PackedScene. Resolve the fallback beneath the selected instance override using
only the existing trusted source grammar and exact dependency hashes. Expose bounded
read-only provenance through the existing describe path; use no new write operation.
The player fills a verified value, then chooses the existing checked authoring flow.

This deliberately does not remove instance properties or promise restored dynamic
inheritance. Equal effective values keep existing no-op and durable receipt behavior.
Unknown source fails closed. Source parsing cannot prove unrelated scripts harmless,
so the existing actual runtime expectation gate remains mandatory for adoption.

Consequences: the feature requires matching private service and Main/UI deployment.
Existing contract metadata and resource formats stay stable. Full desktop and packaged
acceptance are next-cycle integration work; pure and fixed-engine results do not
replace them. See the configuration specification and PP2-defaults dispatch report.
